description: Full ELF inspection in the `elf` namespace using the namespaced-only std.elf model (design §4). Header read capturing raw e_flags before Header.init; file/section/program headers; symbols/dynamic-symbols; relocs/dynamic-relocs with per-arch symbolic names; dynamic section; summary; --all-headers composition; sbpfVersionName helper. Depends on FEAT-001 (signature + Options). Retains the section-header array and symbol value->name table for FEAT-003 to consume.
steps: Header read (§4.1): `const ident = try r.peek(@sizeOf(std.elf.Elf64.Ehdr));` (non-consuming); endian from `ident[std.elf.EI.DATA]` via `@backingInt(std.elf.DATA.@"2LSB")`->.little / `@"2MSB"`->.big (else d.failParse); is_64 from `ident[std.elf.EI.CLASS]` via `@backingInt(std.elf.CLASS.@"64")`->true / `@"32"`->false (else d.failParse); `const raw = if (is_64) try r.takeStruct(std.elf.Elf64.Ehdr, endian) else try r.takeStruct(std.elf.Elf32.Ehdr, endian);` `const e_flags: u32 = raw.flags.int;` (capture BEFORE init) `const hdr = std.elf.Header.init(raw, endian);`.

Add `fn sbpfVersionName(flags: u32) []const u8` in the elf namespace: 0x3 -> "sbpfv3", else format `sbpfv<low-byte>` into a small buffer. Code comment: only 0x3 is produced/verified by sig today; v0/v1 boundary intentionally not asserted. (Also consumed by FEAT-003.)

--file-headers (§4.1): print class (ELF32/ELF64 from is_64), data (2's complement little/big endian from endian), os/abi `{t}` on OSABI + abi version int, type `{t}` on ET + number, machine via explicit `w.print("{t} ({d})", .{ m, @intFromEnum(m) })` with m: std.elf.EM, entry/phoff/shoff via `coff.fmtIntField(d, v, .{ .kind = .va })`, sizes via `.size`, and e_flags: raw hex AND decode (EM.BPF -> `0x3 (sbpfv3)` via sbpfVersionName; other machines raw int). All lines element/redaction aware.

Section-name strtab: seek to shstrndx section's offset, `r.readAlloc(gpa, size)` with `defer gpa.free`; resolve each section name via `std.mem.sliceTo(strtab[name..], 0)` with a bounds check (name >= strtab.len -> d.failParse).

--section-headers (§4.2): iterate `hdr.iterateSectionHeaders(d.fr)` yielding Elf64.Shdr; render index, name, type via `{t}` on shdr.type (SHT, non-exhaustive), AXW letters read directly from shdr.flags.shf.ALLOC/EXECINSTR/WRITE bools, addr(.va), offset(.va), size(.size), link, info, addralign, entsize; --only-section via filterMatches(d.opts.section_filters, name); --table-header gated column line. Retain the shdr array in `std.ArrayList(std.elf.Elf64.Shdr)` from d.gpa with `defer list.deinit(gpa)` for symbols/relocs/dynamic/disasm.

--program-headers / --segments (§4.3): iterate `hdr.iterateProgramHeaders(d.fr)` yielding Elf64.Phdr; type via `{t}` (PT), RWE from flags.R/flags.W/flags.X bools, offset/vaddr/paddr(.va), filesz/memsz(.size), @"align"; --table-header gated.

--symbols / --dynamic-symbols (§4.4): one routine parameterized by (SHT.SYMTAB + linked .strtab) vs (SHT.DYNSYM + .dynstr). Find section; its `link` names the strtab section. GUARD entsize before dividing: `const esz = @sizeOf(std.elf.Elf64.Sym);` (or Elf32.Sym on 32-bit) `if (shdr.entsize == 0 or shdr.entsize < esz) d.failParse("symbol section has invalid entsize 0x{x}", .{shdr.entsize});` then `const count = shdr.size / shdr.entsize;`. Seek + `r.takeStruct(std.elf.Elf64.Sym, endian)` x count. Render value(.va), size(.size), type sym.info.type `{t}`, bind sym.info.bind `{t}`, visibility sym.other.visibility `{t}` (all typed packed fields, NO @enumFromInt/masking), shndx via `fn shndxName(ix: u16) ?[]const u8` switch (SHN_UNDEF->UNDEF, SHN_ABS->ABS, SHN_COMMON->COMMON, else null -> numeric via coff.fmtIntField(.ord)), name from linked strtab. --only-symbol via filterMatches. Retain value->name slices in a `std.heap.ArenaAllocator.init(gpa)` (defer deinit) as a `[]const SymName{value,name}` for FEAT-003.

--relocs / --dynamic-relocs (§4.5): iterate SHT.RELA / SHT.REL sections; section.info -> applied section (name in table header), section.link -> symbol table. Same entsize guard against @sizeOf(Elf64.Rela)/@sizeOf(Elf64.Rel). Read `r.takeStruct(std.elf.Elf64.Rela, endian)` x count. Per entry: offset(.va); symbolic type via `fn relocTypeName(machine: std.elf.EM, raw: u32)` that switches machine to select R_BPF/R_X86_64/R_AARCH64/R_RISCV and prints `w.print("R_<fam>_{t}", .{rt})` (handler prepends prefix; {t} is only the suffix), unknown machine -> raw numeric + "(unknown arch)"; validate rela.info.sym < symbol count before name resolution (else d.failParse); symbol name; addend for RELA. On 32-bit widen Elf32.Rel.Info.type (u8) to u32 before @enumFromInt.

--dynamic (§4.6): find SHT.DYNAMIC; `hdr.iterateDynamicSection(d.fr, offset, size)` yielding Elf64.Dyn; tag via `fn dtName(tag: i64) []const u8` (DT_NEEDED/STRTAB/SYMTAB/RELA/RELASZ/SONAME/FLAGS/FLAGS_1/INIT/FINI/..., else 0x hex); dyn.val (.va for pointer-like tags, .size for size tags, else plain). No dynamic section -> clean 'no dynamic section' line, not an error.

--summary (§4.7): one machine-parseable line through coff.fmtIntField so redaction applies: `type={t} machine={t}({d}) entry=... class=ELF.. data=.. flags=0x..(sbpfvN) phnum=.. shnum=..` (machine two-part print w.print("{t}({d})", .{m, @intFromEnum(m)})).
--all-headers composition (§4.8): honor file_headers/section_headers/symbols/relocs plus the FEAT-001-OR'd program_headers/dynamic.

Allocator discipline (§2.1): single `const gpa = d.gpa;`; every readAlloc/ArrayList paired with defer free/deinit(gpa); symbol-name table via local ArenaAllocator.init(gpa) with defer deinit() (mirror coff.dumpObject).
acceptance_criteria: `sig test lib/compiler/objdump.sig` compiles clean under strict mode (allocator discipline verified by the compiler).

On a native ELF input, `sig objdump --summary` prints the single-line summary, `--file-headers` shows machine as `<NAME> (<num>)` and decoded e_flags, `--section-headers`/`--program-headers`/`--symbols`/`--relocs`/`--dynamic` produce stable, element-gated, redaction-aware output.
A symbol/reloc section with entsize==0 or entsize < entry size triggers d.failParse rather than a division-by-zero/garbage read.
The section-header array and symbol value->name table are retained and exposed for FEAT-003.
verification: Manual: produce an ELF (e.g. compile a .sig to an ELF object/exe for a linux target) and run `sig objdump --summary`, `--file-headers`, `-s --section-headers`, `--relocs`; confirm no TODO/crash and stable output. If no ELF input is available in-env, record the `sig test` pass + reason in findings.
findings:
DONE. All edits confined to lib/compiler/objdump.sig (worktree copy; COFF arm and every coff.* fn untouched -> COFF byte-identical). `sig test lib/compiler/objdump.sig` compiles clean under strict mode, All 0 tests passed.

IMPLEMENTED (elf namespace, design §4): header read captures raw e_flags via raw.flags.int BEFORE Header.init -- peek @sizeOf(Elf64.Ehdr), branch class/endian off ident[EI.CLASS]/[EI.DATA] with @backingInt(CLASS/DATA), takeStruct(Elf64/Elf32.Ehdr) to grab e_flags, then seekTo(0) + std.elf.Header.read(r) for an iterator-ready Header. sbpfVersionName(flags:u32, buf:*[16]u8) ([]const u8). --file-headers (class/data/os-abi/abi-version/type/machine `{NAME} ({d})`/entry/phoff/shoff/sizes/flags with sBPF decode). --section-headers, --program-headers/--segments, --symbols/--dynamic-symbols (entsize guard), --relocs/--dynamic-relocs (entsize guard + per-arch R_<fam>_ names + sym-index bounds check), --dynamic (clean 'no dynamic section'), --summary, --all-headers composition. Strict allocator discipline: single d.gpa, every readAlloc/ArrayList paired with defer free/deinit(gpa), symbol-name table in a local ArenaAllocator.init(gpa) (defer deinit).

CRITICAL TOOLCHAIN FINDING (deviates from design assumption, affects FEAT-003): the design claims `{t}` on a non-exhaustive enum prints the numeric value for an unnamed tag. IT DOES NOT -- the installed sig 0.6.1 formatter calls @tagName and PANICS 'invalid enum value' (verified: a real x86_64 ELF with SHT.X86_64_UNWIND=0x70000001 segfaulted the first build). FIX: never format an enum read from a file with `{t}`. All enum rendering goes through `fn writeEnum(w: *Io.Writer, comptime E: type, value: E, width: usize) !void` (in the elf namespace) which uses std.enums.tagName(E, value) orelse '0x{x}' fallback, with optional right-pad to `width`. FEAT-003 MUST use writeEnum (or the same tagName-guard) for any opcode/enum it renders, not `{t}`.

RETAINED FOR FEAT-003 (exact names/signatures, all inside `const elf = struct {...}` in lib/compiler/objdump.sig):
1. Section-header array: `var sections: std.ArrayList(std.elf.Elf64.Shdr) = .empty;` (local in `fn dump`), `defer sections.deinit(gpa);`, populated by iterating hdr.iterateSectionHeaders(fr) and appending every Elf64.Shdr. Indexed by section number; element fields used downstream: .type (SHT), .flags.shf.EXECINSTR (find .text), .offset, .size, .link, .info, .name (u32 offset into the shstrtab). To find executable sections for disasm: iterate sections.items and test `sh.flags.shf.EXECINSTR`.
2. Section-name string table: `var shstrtab: []u8` (gpa-owned, freed via defer), resolved per-section via `fn sectionName(d: *const DumpContext, strtab: []const u8, name: u32) []const u8` (bounds-checked, failParse on overflow).
3. Symbol value->name table: `const SymName = struct { value: u64, name: []const u8 };` (declared at top of the elf namespace). Built in `fn dumpSymbols` into `var sym_names: std.ArrayList(SymName) = .empty;` (local in `fn dump`, `defer sym_names.deinit(gpa)`), with name slices duped into `var name_arena: std.heap.ArenaAllocator = .init(gpa); defer name_arena.deinit();`. Only the SYMTAB pass populates it (retain=true); it is std.mem.sort'd ascending by .value so FEAT-003 can binary-search a code address -> symbol name. For FEAT-003/§6.1 the Annotator should take `syms: []const SymName = sym_names.items` plus header.machine.

HELPERS added for FEAT-003 reuse: sbpfVersionName (sBPF version string from e_flags), writeEnum (panic-safe enum rendering -- MANDATORY), shndxName, dtName/dtKind, printRelocType(w, machine, raw).

VERIFICATION: `sig test lib/compiler/objdump.sig` -> All 0 tests passed. No sBPF/Solana toolchain in-env, so manual smoke used an x86_64-linux ELF object built with `sig build-obj -target x86_64-linux` (SIG_LIB_DIR pointed at the worktree lib so objdump loads the edited file; also built a standalone debug exe with `sig build-exe lib/compiler/objdump.sig` for crash traces). Confirmed stable, element-gated, redaction-aware output for --summary, --file-headers (machine 'X86_64 (62)'), --section-headers (unknown type 0x70000001 renders numerically, AXW flags correct), --symbols (type/bind/vis/ndx/name, incl SECTION/FILE/FUNC/OBJECT), --relocs (R_X86_64_64 + addend + resolved symbol names), --dynamic ('no dynamic section'), -s snapshot redaction (va/size -> xxxx), and --all-headers composition. The sBPF-specific paths (R_BPF_*, sbpfVersionName=='sbpfv3' for 0x3) are comptime-reachable and compile clean; sBPF snapshot cases deferred to CI per context.json. Committed locally on the branch; not pushed.
